feeds.title: Emily Henderson
feeds.description: Style By Emily Henderson is an Interior Design and Home Decor Blog. Some of the key topics covered are design trends, makeovers, budget decor, lifestyle, business advice, and more. It is run by a small team of like-minded people who share my passion for design, style, and human connection. Emily Henderson is a stylist, author, and T.V. host with a strong commitment to vintage inspired approachable home style.

feeds.title: COCOCOZY
feeds.description: Get inspired by Home-styling and Interior Decor tips from Coco at our blog. COCOCOZY is a daily lifestyle publication, curated by Los Angeles-based blogger Coco, featuring the best of home decor, fashion, travel, food, and style. Our goal is simple - provide design and style inspiration with a personal and sometimes humorous approach.

feeds.title: Old Brand New Blog
feeds.description: Old Brand New blog is about how to blend art into everyday things like Living Room Decor, Interior, and other Home DIY furniture. Founded by Dabito, a photographer, artist, and décor guru, Old Brand New is a creative studio specializing in Design, Art Direction, Branding, Photography, and Brand Partnerships.

feeds.title: Jill Seidner Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Jill Seidner is a Los Angeles-based Interior Designer specializing in commercial & residential interior design, design consultations, & online design services. She is active in the design community & also the Los Angeles blogger for the Material Girls Blog. Find decor and interior designing tips, trends, DIY tips and more!

feeds.title: West Virginia Coal Association News
feeds.description: A source for insider interior design tips and behind-the-scenes looks. Veneer Designs is an award-winning Los Angeles-based full-service interior design studio founded by Natalie Myers. We bring an organic modern inspired perspective to contemporary spaces. From full home renovations and new construction, space planning, kitchen and bath remodels, to simply helping you pick a color scheme and that perfect end table - we are personally invested in making your interiors our dream space.

feeds.title: 22 Interiors Blog
feeds.description: 22 Interiors blog posts about vendors, interior design, Los Angeles design and design tips. 22 Interiors is a full-service, award-winning interior design agency with residential and commercial projects throughout the United States. We thrive on deciphering a client's idea of the perfect home or commercial environment, translating it into it in a spatial and visual plan, and bringing it to life with an organized installation.

feeds.title: Breegan Jane Blog
feeds.description: Breegan Jane details mom life complete with advice and hilarious tales of motherhood and LA and Venice Beach interior design on her blog. Read more! Breegan Jane is a designer, entrepreneur, lifestyle expert and philanthropist in Los Angeles.

feeds.title: Justina Blakeney Blog
feeds.description: Jungalow began in 2009 as a design blog and has quickly become the go-to source for creative design inspiration. We share inspiration, how-tos and fresh ideas for how to live with color, pattern and plants. Justina is a designer, artist and author who believes that creativity is the key to having an amazing home. The Jungalow is the name of her home, design studio and blog that celebrates color, pattern and plants.

feeds.title: Studio Blu Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on trends, best practices, and seasonal interior designs in Los Angeles by following our blog! Studio Blu, Inc. is an award-winning, full-service interior design firm based in Los Angeles. Design principal Adrienne Mascaro was raised and educated in Chicago and has been a proud Venice Beach and Marina del Rey local for over 20 years.
